api_changes.detail: The Veo guide's samples call client.models.generate_videos and POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{id}:predictLongRunning with a Veo model id. The same page says to migrate to gemini-omni-1.1-flash and says this feature is currently only available with the generateContent API. No generate_videos sample for gemini-omni-1.1-flash was found on that page, so this page does not show a model-id swap.

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for veo-3.0-fast-generate-preview on the linked official page.
Re-check price, context, and parameters on the provider pages linked here.
Ship the change before the published shutdown date.
